independent_decision_rule: Fail for a materially missing close/flow or development, invented or stale market observation, unsupported cause, misleading plan-versus-action status, or unavailable old/new baseline. Duplicates and narrow items may be excluded with concrete reasons. A model publish verdict alone is insufficient.
